description: This file defines the SnapshotRenderer class and related functions for rendering and processing DOM snapshots in the Playwright trace viewer, including URL rewriting, canvas handling, and shadow DOM processing.

classes.name: SnapshotRenderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering DOM snapshots into HTML, handling resource fetching, URL rewriting, and visual annotations for the Playwright trace viewer.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the closest item in a list based on a metric function and target value.

methods.name: isNodeNameAttributesChildNodesSnapshot
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a NodeNameAttributesChildNodesSnapshot.

methods.name: isSubtreeReferenceSnapshot
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a SubtreeReferenceSnapshot.

methods.name: snapshotNodes
methods.description: Extracts all nodes from a FrameSnapshot, caching the result.

methods.name: snapshotScript
methods.description: Generates a script to set up the snapshot environment, including URL rewriting and canvas rendering.

methods.name: rewriteURLForCustomProtocol
methods.description: Rewrites URLs with custom protocols to a sanitized, prefixed HTTPS URL for Electron support.

methods.name: rewriteURLsInStyleSheetForCustomProtocol
methods.description: Rewrites URLs inside CSS stylesheets to handle custom protocols.

methods.name: escapeURLsInStyleSheet
methods.description: Encodes URLs in stylesheets that contain closing tags to prevent HTML parsing issues.

methods.name: unwrapPopoutUrl
methods.description: Extracts the original URL from a pop-out snapshot URL.
